title: Result.tryPromise turns a foreign rejection into the Panic error variant of the awaited Result
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Promise Semantics': 'Promise rejection at an unannotated Smithers foreign boundary MUST become the checked panic case rather than an untyped rejection escaping the declared contract.' `fetchLength` carries no @throws claim and rejects on "boom". poc/src/language/README.md documents Result.tryPromise as the public adapter with the Panic-retaining type.
